description: This file defines a factory function that creates CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) controllers for Mongoose models, supporting list endpoints with caching and tenant-aware filtering. It includes functions for handling list retrieval, get by ID, create, update, and delete operations, along with error handling and micro-cache logic.

methods.name: microGet(key)
methods.description: Retrieves a cached response if it exists and is not expired.

methods.name: microSet(key, payload)
methods.description: Sets a cached response with a specific TTL.

methods.name: buildListKey(req, filter, sort, page, limit, skip, explicit)
methods.description: Constructs a stable cache key for list requests based on request parameters.

methods.name: mapAndReplyError(res, err, context = 'operation')
methods.description: Maps Mongoose errors to user-friendly responses based on error type.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles listing documents with filtering, pagination, sorting, tenant-awareness, and optional micro-caching.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a single document by MongoDB _id, applying tenant filter if present.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new document, automatically stamping tenant_id if available.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a document identified by _id, considering tenant filter if applicable.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a document by _id, considering tenant filter if applicable.

calls: Model.findOneAndUpdate({ _id: id, tenant_id: req.auth.tenantId }, data, { new: true })
